title: One-use authentication records
responsibility: Provide conditional database operations for login challenges, GitHub state and native handoffs.

inputs.name: d1OneTimeStores.db
inputs.description: The D1-compatible database handle, which must provide prepare(query) and statements with bind, run and first. It is used only when a store method is called, never by d1OneTimeStores itself, and a database error reaches that method's caller unchanged.

inputs.name: d1OneTimeStores.records
inputs.description: The validator that turns each row returned by challenges.claim, githubStates.claim, exchanges.find or exchanges.claim into a typed record. A row that fails validation makes that call throw, and create and approve never use it.

outputs.name: d1OneTimeStores
outputs.description: Three stores over the same handle: challenges and githubStates each offer create and claim, where claim atomically deletes and returns an unexpired row or null, and exchanges offers create, find (any status, expired or not), approve and claim. Approve moves a pending, unexpired native exchange with the given code hash to approved, sets its subject and parentHash, and returns false otherwise; claim moves an approved, unexpired native exchange to consumed and returns it to one caller, and every other claim returns null.

errors.name: Corrupt stored Hub authentication record
errors.description: Thrown with the message 'Hub auth record corrupt' by challenges.claim, githubStates.claim, exchanges.find and exchanges.claim when a row fails validation: the row is not an object, a required text column is not a non-empty string, a required integer column is not a safe integer, or an exchange's environment or status is not one of its allowed values.

errors.name: database rejection
errors.description: Any error from the D1Like handle's prepare, bind, run or first, which every store method leaves uncaught so that the caller receives the handle's own error unchanged.
